Information for Parents
Mykolayiv National Agrarian University is the leading institution of higher education of the South of Ukraine! Agrarian University is a powerful material and technical resources, a center of innovative designing, a source of human resources both for the Southern region and for the whole of Ukraine. It has close ties with production and productively cooperates with many foreign partners. And most importantly, the University is the only family of students and teaching staff united by a common purpose, ideas, and ambitions.
The University provides professional training for
Bachelor’s
and
Master’s
degrees in 23 specialties.
The Mykolayiv National Agrarian University ensures the unity of education, science, production by implementing the program of innovative and investment projects “Integration of education, science, production”, developed by the scientists of the University and experts for 2016-2022.
The main purpose of the University activity is to train highly qualified specialists who will acquire the necessary competencies with the possibility of their implementation.
During the university admissions process, an important aspect is to take into account all the features,
recommendations
, and advice to intending students to the Mykolayiv National Agrarian University in 2019, which contribute to a fuller understanding and simplify the procedure of admission to the University.
The main thing for admission to the University is the successful passage of EIT (External Independent Testing) in the subjects chosen by an entrant. Given the versatility and the availability of different combinations of subjects, we have developed the
EIT – 2019 Calculator
, which will immediately show the specialties that you can enter.
The University provides enrollment for 1207 places on free of charge education (state-financed education) in all specialties for full-time and part-time studies. Also,
85 places funded from the local budget
have allocated to Mykolayiv National Agrarian University that increases the chances of entrants from rural areas.
The procedure of recommendation letter receipt for enrollment in the Mykolayiv NAU for places which funded from the local budget
It should also be noted that studying at the University is carried out at the lowest prices in the South of Ukraine on the contract (at the expense of individuals and legal entities) for both
bachelors
and
masters
.
Living conditions in
four student hostels
are the best not only in the region but also in Ukraine. This is evidenced by the results of the competition among the agrarian higher education institutions of Ukraine “Hostel – Our Home”, where hostels of the Mykolayiv National Agrarian University have been firmly in the first place for the last four years. The price of accommodation in hostels is the lowest in the Mykolayiv area. The University has a Catering Centre, the purpose of which is to reduce the cost of food prices, to provide adequate nutrition for students, teachers, and staff of the University. University students have the opportunity to eat in student canteens at low prices.
During studying at Mykolayiv National Agrarian University, III-VI year students can simultaneously study under the reserve officers training program and receive the rank of junior reserve lieutenant.
II-V year students of the Mykolayiv National Agrarian University have the opportunity to take
internships
at modern agricultural enterprises of Germany, Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Switzerland, France, Great Britain, Netherlands, Poland, USA, Canada, and Australia.
Youth always represents the future of humanity. Wishing to participate in the life of society, a student becomes the leader of social change of economic development and progress of society. The creative potential of higher education learners of Mykolayiv National Agrarian University is fully realized based on the cultural and art center “Ekspromt”, the main task of which is the formation of interests of students for art, assessment, and development of individual creative abilities and aptitudes, organization of student’s leisure. The structure of the center includes 11 clubs and amateur studios. The students’ academic ambitions and achievements are multiplied by the opportunities of the Physical Training Department.
